title: Đây không phải là phòng tôi đã đặt
englishTitle: This is not the room I booked
pronunciation: Day khong phai la phong toi da dat
summary: For showing the booking does not match the room you were given.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: The key works, but the room type, bed setup, view, or floor is not what you booked.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the booking screen next to the room detail. Let staff compare the mismatch before adding more.

phrases.vietnamese: Đây không phải là phòng tôi đã đặt
phrases.english: This is not the room I booked
phrases.pronunciation: Day khong phai la phong toi da dat

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Đây không phải means this is not; phòng tôi đã đặt means the room I booked.

breakdown.vietnamese: Đây không phải là phòng tôi đã đặt
breakdown.english: This is not the room I booked

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Reservation and check-in phrases help reopen the desk conversation if the booking has to be found.

phrases.english: I’d like to check in, please

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at check-in or right after entering the room, before unpacking or accepting the change.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Keep the exact room type visible: bed count, window, floor, or included feature.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: If the desk needs another path, ask about a different room, confirm the reservation name, request a higher or quieter room, or discuss a refund.
